programme.desc: Le renard a trouvé un moyen d'avoir les poulets : la magie ! // Power Pooch veut sauver le lieutenant, quand il découvre que le Power Shoe a disparu. // Genghis cherche la maison d'un souverain. Mais les cartes de Khannie mènent Genghis vers un Yéti.

programme.title: Le Monde Fou de Tex Avery: Frankeinstone ! // Atlantis s'en fiche // Mini le Moutch
programme.desc: Tex et Sid peinent à jouer "Magnifiques 7" quand un directeur fait des coupes budgétaires. // Gengis est un agent secret du H.O.R.D.E. qui doit voler un sérum top secret. // Einstone apprend à une Néandertalienne à se laver, à s'habiller et à parler.

programme.title: Le Monde Fou de Tex Avery: Euh-mesticated // Cousin bourdonnant // 20/20 La sagesse de la meute
programme.desc: Einstone veut savoir comment les hommes de Neandertal rencontrent des filles. // Genghis et l'Empereur ont conquis la planète, sauf l'Atlantide et son trésor. // Mooch veut ajouter Maurice à une recette et l'aide dans son expérience scientifique.

programme.title: Kangoo
programme.desc: Alors que les Kangoo disputent un match contre les Pirates, une tarentule géante apparait et enlève Lady Daisy et Tiffanie. Lancés à la poursuite du monstre, les Kangoo découvrent que les tarentules ne cessent de se multiplier.

programme.title: Kangoo
programme.desc: La reine du Misyaland jette son dévolu sur Nelson qu'elle décide d'épouser. Totalement grisé, celui-ci snobe ses amis en se prenant pour un vrai prince. Les Kangoo, Samy et Tiffanie sont bien décidés à empêcher ce mariage stupide.

programme.title: Secrets de Musées: Le musée de l'Ermitage de Saint-Pétersbourg
programme.desc: Fondé au XVIIIe siècle par la tsarine Catherine II de Russie, passionnée d'art, l'Ermitage possède les collections muséales les plus riches du monde.

programme.title: Secrets de Musées: Le Musée archéologique d'Athènes
programme.desc: Les vastes collections du Musée national archéologique d'Athènes offrent un panorama complet de la civilisation grecque du VIIe siècle avant J-C jusqu'à la fin de l'Antiquité.

programme.title: Secrets de Musées: Le Musée royal de l'Ontario
programme.desc: Le paléontologue David Evans a fouillé dans les réserves du Musée royal de l'Ontario pour reconstituer un squelette de barosaure acquis dans les années 60.

programme.title: Secrets de Musées: Le Musée d'Histoire naturelle de Londres
programme.desc: Au Musée d'Histoire naturelle de Londres, le personnel s'interroge notamment sur les moeurs alimentaires des hommes préhistoriques de Grande-Bretagne.

programme.title: Secrets de Musées: Le Louvre
programme.desc: Le public peut voir les 36 000 oeuvres exposées dans les salles du musée du Louvre, mais n'a pas accès aux réserves où sont stockées 265 000 pièces.

programme.title: Namoroka: Le Monde Perdu
programme.desc: Durant plusieurs semaines, une équipe internationale de 22 chercheurs va tenter d’atteindre et d’explorer pour la première fois le cœur de cette Terra Incognita, véritable temple de la biodiversité où tout reste à découvrir.

programme.title: Namoroka: La Quête du Graal
programme.desc: Durant plusieurs semaines, une équipe internationale de 22 chercheurs va tenter d’atteindre et d’explorer pour la première fois le cœur de cette Terra Incognita, véritable temple de la biodiversité où tout reste à découvrir.

programme.title: Les mystères du Mékong: Cambodge : cycles saisonniers
programme.desc: Comment les animaux survivent-ils à la saison sèche près du Mékong au Cambodge ?

programme.title: Les mystères du Mékong: Vietnam : vie dans le Delta
programme.desc: Parcourez le delta du Mékong vietnamien, où les cours d'eau fourmillent de vies.

programme.title: Les mystères du Mékong: Vietnam : fin du voyage
programme.desc: Découvrez comment le Mékong crée des écosystèmes uniques sur la côte du Vietnam.

programme.title: Chacun son Île
programme.desc: Creuset du Portugal et de l'Afrique, au large du Sénégal, le Cap-Vert regorge de paysages variés et riches.

programme.title: Ratz

programme.title: Ratz

programme.title: Ratz

programme.title: Ratz

programme.title: Ratz

programme.title: Ratz

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Un ingénieur monte à bord pour tester son prototype de moteur fonctionnant au fromage. Et ça marche plutôt bien !

programme.title: Ratz

programme.title: Ratz

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Alors que les deux rats jettent à la mer des vieux fromages périmés, une loutre écolo les rabroue vertement et monte à bord pour vérifier si le cargo est bien aux normes écologiques.

programme.title: Ratz

programme.title: Wicked Tuna

programme.title: Les 100 lieux qu'il faut voir
programme.desc: Côtes escarpées, eaux translucides ou forêts peuplées de légendes : la découverte du Finistère, de Quimper à Morlaix en passant par Landerneau, concentre tout ce qui fait le charme de la Bretagne.

programme.title: Les 100 lieux qu'il faut voir
programme.desc: Découvrez les secrets et les beautés du Berry lors d'une promenade à travers les merveilles de cette région. De Bourges à la biodiversité préservée des Marais, laissez vous surprendre par un patrimoine riche.

programme.title: Les 100 lieux qu'il faut voir
programme.desc: Sur ses 361 kilomètres de long, la Charente a très tôt transporté des gabarres aux mille trésors. Henri IV la qualifiait simplement de plus beau ruisseau de France. Au rythme de cette rivière, les grandes maisons de négoce ont prospéré.

programme.title: Les 100 lieux qu'il faut voir
programme.desc: La côte normande séduit autant les amoureux des grands espaces que les curieux épris de patrimoine et d'histoire. Cette terre de contrastes, éprouvée par les guerres au fil des siècles, a toujours su renaître de ses cendres.

programme.title: Les 100 lieux qu'il faut voir
programme.desc: Le Val-de-Loire offre un éventail infini de paysages bucoliques et de monuments somptueux. Parmi ses forêts luxuriantes se dressent les plus beaux châteaux de l'Hexagone, où s'inscrivent des pages entières de l'Histoire.

programme.desc: Babouche et Bébé Jaguar organisent un grand spectacle de cirque. Aide Diego et Dora à trouver le chapiteau où aura lieu le spectacle.

programme.title: Go Diego !
programme.desc: Diego doit trouver une nouvelle maison au Tapir, où elle pourra manger de l'herbe, nager dans l'eau et être à l'abri du soleil.

programme.title: Go Diego !
programme.desc: Bébé jaguar n'a besoin que de trois autres sauvetages pour obtenir son brevet de sauvetage d'animaux ! On dirait qu'aujourd'hui va être une journée bien remplie pour Diego et bébé jaguar.

programme.title: Blaze et les Monster Machines
programme.desc: Zeg, Blaze et AJ s'amusent à une version tout-terrain du Chamboule-Tout, lorsqu'ils tombent nez à nez avec un gros œuf jaune et violet.

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes Dehors!
programme.desc: La team Top Wing cherche à sauver deux oies perdues dans le brouillard. // C'est l'été, et le cocorico matinal de Rod réveille un peu trop tôt les autres élèves officiers...

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes Dehors!
programme.desc: Le capitaine Dilly et les cadets créent une zone de pirates. Mais le capitaine Swabby s'empare des coffres au trésor ! // Les Dodos prennent Brody pour le légendaire Roi des dodos et suivent ses ordres, jusqu'à ce que Bandit s'empare de la couronne !

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes Dehors!
programme.desc: Le capitaine Dilly enrôle Cheep, Chirp et leurs amis pour récupérer la clef d'un coffre au trésor tombée au fond d'un conduit. // La famille de Rod vient passer la journée à la base.

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes Dehors!
programme.desc: L'œuf de printemps du commodore transporté par Sandy est égaré.

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: Dora et Babouche lisent des livres à la bibliothèque. Val la pieuvre leur confie une mission : plonger au cœur de trois livres différents et rapporter trois objets pour compléter le mur d'histoires.

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: Dora est au Brésil, pour disputer la Coupe d'Or avec son équipe de football, l'équipe des explorateurs, et Paula, son amie brésilienne. Pour remporter la coupe, ils devront affronter trois équipes, les Samba Trees, les Dinosaurs et les Monsters.

programme.title: Bubulle Guppies
programme.desc: Si Sandy, la nouvelle amie de Molly, ne termine pas son travail à temps, elle ne sera peut-être pas courronnée reine de la plage au bal de la plage !

programme.title: Bubulle Guppies
programme.desc: Le Cirque des Frères Bubulle arrive en ville et tous les Guppies font partie du spectacle ! Admirez Gody le clown, Gil l'acrobate, Oona la dresseuse de lions... Mais attention aux tartes ! SPLASH !

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le goût de la vengeance
programme.desc: Karai est enfermée dans les prisons de Shredder. Les tortues la font évader et la ramènent au repaire. Splinter lui explique l'histoire de la guerre entre le Clan des Foot et la famille Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fantôme de Chinatown
programme.desc: Pendant qu'ils cherchent Karaï, les tortues croisent les Dragons Pourpres qui paraissent beaucoup plus forts qu'à l'accoutumée. En effet, un mystérieux esprit sorti d'une dague les a dotés de pouvoirs. L'un maîtrise la foudre ; l'autre, le tonnerre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage dans la Dimension X
programme.desc: En voulant trouver une source d'énergie pour sa Tortue Mécha, Donnie ouvre un portail vers la dimension X. Il capte alors un message de Leatherhead, qui est prisonnier des Krangs. Celui-ci l'informe que les Krangs ont perfectionné le mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 1
programme.desc: Les tortues n'ont toujours pas retrouvé Karaï. L'inquiétude atteint son paroxysme lorsque Splinter leur annonce que l'invasion des Krangs est imminente. Dans la ville, April et Irma sont poursuivies par des Footbots.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 2
programme.desc: Suite du premier épisode. Léo se bat contre les acolytes de Shredder et affronte successivement les Footbots, Tiger Claw et Fishface. Puis Shredder porte le dernier coup et fendille sa carapace. Le père d'April est « krang-formé ».

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au fond des bois
programme.desc: Après l'invasion de New York, April, Casey et les tortues trouvent refuge dans la maison de campagne de la famille O'Neil. Trois mois ont passé et Leonardo est toujours inconscient.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La chasse au Big Foot
programme.desc: Raphael organise une partie de cache-cache dans la forêt pour que Mikey et Donnie apprivoisent leur nouvel environnement. Mais ils tombent nez-à-nez avec une créature légendaire, le Big Foot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Secrets enfouis
programme.desc: Lors d'un grand nettoyage dans la maison de campagne, April et les tortues découvrent un vaisseau Krang caché dans la cave. La mère d'April y était conservée en hibernation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'attaque des Grenouilles-Mutantes
programme.desc: Mikey a encore tout saccagé dans le salon en rejouant une scène de Crognard le Barbare. Ses frères lui passent un savon et le forcent à nettoyer, ce qui le pousse à s'enfuir dans la forêt.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mauvais rêves
programme.desc: En revenant de l'épicerie locale, Casey et April trouvent les tortues faisant la sieste. Casey s'indigne tandis qu'April s'inquiète car elle n'arrive pas à les réveiller.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fou du volant
programme.desc: Casey et Donnie croisent un dangereux chauffard sur la route. Ils apprennent aux informations qu'il est activement recherché et décident de le prendre en chasse.

programme.title: iCarly: On peut toujours rêver
programme.desc: iCarly demande à ses fans d'envoyer des vidéos d'eux-mêmes pratiquant leur plus belle danse. Carly, Sam et Freddie recoivent plus de 3000 vidéos et se retrouvent à veiller toute la nuit pour les regarder.

programme.title: iCarly: Joyeux Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie tournent iCarly dans un appartement prétendument hanté. Quand des choses étranges se mettent à se passer, les amis se demandent si les rumeurs de fantômes ne sont pas fondées...

programme.title: iCarly: Nevel pirate iCarly
programme.desc: Spencer sauve la vie du chanteur de The Plain White T's et le convainc de participer à iCarly. Mais des choses étranges se mettent à arriver sur le plateau et l'on se rend vite compte que c'est Nevel qui essaye de saboter iCarly...

programme.title: iCarly: J'ai été collée
programme.desc: Sam est punie la nuit de la cinquantième émission d'iCarly. Inapte à faire l'enregistrement, Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour être punis à leur tour afin de diffuser l'émission durant la nuit, avec Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Mauvaise promotion
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie sont invités au QG de la marque de chaussures Daka, où on leur offre une belle somme d'argent pour essayer les nouvelles chaussures Daka, "Tech-foot", sur iCarly..

programme.title: iCarly: La promesse
programme.desc: Carly obtient un B à un devoir d'Histoire pour lequel elle pensait avoir un A. Durant sa réunion hebdomadaire avec le principal Franklin, Sam change la note sur l'ordinateur et surprend Carly avec le A qu'elle mérite.

programme.title: iCarly: On passe à la télé
programme.desc: Un producteur très influent veut transposer iCarly à la télévision. Mais Carly, Sam et Freddie sont vite décontenancés par les changements que le producteur veut opérer dans l'émission...

programme.title: iCarly: Un petit ami très envahissant
programme.desc: Sam se trouve un petit ami, et ces deux là sont inséparables. Mais quand leur relation se met à interférer avec iCarly, Carly et Freddie savent qu'ils doivent intervenir.

programme.title: iCarly: Les videos pirates
programme.desc: Après avoir regardé un extrait d'iCarly qui montre un homme vendre des copies illégales de films, deux détectives décident de se servir de Carly et Spencer pour leur enquête.

programme.title: iCarly: En route pour l'université
programme.desc: Carly apprend que son émission lui ouvre les portes d'une scolarité dans une école privée très cotée. Carly doute encore, mais Sam et Freddie savent qu'ils n'ont pas envie de la voir partir...

programme.title: iCarly: Adversaires
programme.desc: Freddie part faire de l'escrime avec Spencer. Il s'en sort bien, mais les choses se compliquent lorsque Spencer se retrouve impliqué dans un match avec l'incroyable Doug Toder.

programme.desc: Humans face their fears in a hilarious showdown. Luckily, laughter the best armor against unexpected twists!

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Bellagio Cup VI - Part 2
programme.desc: Five days of grueling poker competiton come to an end in the WPT Bellagio Cup VI, as Moritz Kranich, Justin Smith, Phil Ivey, and John Caridad battle for the $875,000 top prize.

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Legends of Poker
programme.desc: The World Poker Tour Legends of Poker final table is set, with Andy Frankenberger and Jared Jaffee headlining.

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Borgata Poker Open
programme.desc: A massive field of 1,042 entries turned up for the WPT Borgata Poker Open, and just six players remain in contention for the $734,000 top prize.

programme.title: Rocket Power: Otto 3000 / Le rôdeur
programme.desc: Dès le départ d'une compétition, Otto casse sa planche de snowboard. Un manager lui propose de le sponsoriser et de lui fournir du matériel. Battu au hockey et vexé, Otto accepte de prendre sa revanche en pleine nuit.

programme.title: Rocket Power: La fête d'anniversaire / Les Rocket à la rescousse
programme.desc: L'anniversaire de Reggie, qui doit se dérouler au Skate-Park, est fortement compromis car les enfants en ont été exclus pour une semaine. Contre leur gré, la mère de Sam et celle de Twister inscrivent leurs enfants à des cours de sauvetage en mer.

programme.title: Rocket Power: Twister fait du baby-sitting / Les grandes déferlantes
programme.desc: Twister qui avait prévu de se rendre avec ses amis à la fête foraine, se voit contraint de garder son cousin. Une mission qui va vite se révéler très mouvementée. Les enfants décident de suivre Rhino qui part surfer sur des vagues monstrueuses.

programme.title: Rocket Power: Les associés / Papa a une journée de congé
programme.desc: La bande se lamente car la mer est trop calme. La solution serait un scooter des mers. Sam, dont le père travaille dans le Kansas, apprend que celui-ci vient lui rendre visite.

programme.title: Rocket Power: Vive les surfeuses / Du cinéma en Twister vision
programme.desc: Otto se fait accoster par un journaliste qui s'intéresse aux surfeurs et veut faire un article sur lui. Twister montre le film qu'il a réalisé. Otto déchante quand il voit que Twister a intégré ses chutes.

programme.title: Rocket Power: Un nouveau au Skate-Park / les lugeurs de la route
programme.desc: Une nouvelle attraction est inaugurée au Skate-Park et Otto y voit une occasion de briller devant les caméras de la télé. Otto et Twister découvrent une nouvelle discipline : la luge sur route. Twister s'avère meilleur qu'Otto.

programme.title: Rocket Power: D comme déprime / Délit de skate
programme.desc: Otto vient d'avoir une mauvaise note. / Otto laisse traîner sa planche. M. Stimpleton glisse dessus. Feignant d'être blessé, il arrive à faire interdire tout sport en ville.

programme.title: Rocket Power: Skate informatique / Reviens mollusque
programme.desc: Quand on est un champion de skate comme les Rocket, peut-on accepter un défi lancé par un ordinateur ? / En allant chercher une balle de hockey perdue lors d'une partie dans un magasin, le Mollusque fait une étrange rencontre et délaisse le match.

programme.title: Rocket Power: Le mensonge ne paye pas / Règlement de compte
programme.desc: Reggie s'entraîne pour le Triathlon Junior. Fatiguée des moqueries d'Otto et Twister, Reggie publie un numéro spécial de son fanzine révélant leurs secrets.

programme.title: Rocket Power: Le mal du pays / Perdue retrouvée

programme.title: Victorious FR: Un Mauvais Réalisateur
programme.desc: Un réalisateur assez connu Dale Squires doit réaliser un film avec Tori Beck Jade André Cat Robbie mais il n'est jamais sur le tournage et c'est Tori qui réalise le film. Le film a du succès et Dale dit que c'est lui qui l'a entièrement réalisé.

programme.title: Victorious FR: La mort de Rex
programme.desc: Alors que les enfants préparent une pièce importante, Rex est accidentellement avalé par un ventilateur géant... et c'est la faute de Tori. Si elle veut que Robbie se remette émotionnellement, elle va devoir sauver la vie de Rex...

programme.title: Victorious FR: L'ex Petit Ami de Tori
programme.desc: Daniel l'ex petit ami de Tori sort maintenant avec Cat. Tori ne l'a pas vraiment oublié et l'embrasse devant Cat. Elles se fâchent puis se réconcilient.

programme.title: Victorious FR: Télé réalité à Hollywood Arts
programme.desc: Une télé réalité est tournée à Hollywood Arts avec Beck et Tori comme comédiens principaux. Les producteurs montent une fausse conversation entre Tori et Beck qui laisse croire à Jade que Beck à une aventure avec Tori.

programme.title: Victorious FR: Tori, la Raquette Ravageuse
programme.desc: Cat, Beck, Jade, Robbie et André montent une fausse équipe de ping-pong pour toucher une subvention de l'école de 1500 dollars afin d'aller dîner dans un grand restaurant. Tori découvre l'arnaque.

programme.title: Victorious FR: La pièce de Jade
programme.desc: Jade a écrit une pièce mais l'école refuse qu'elle soit jouée dans le grand théâtre. Il lui faut 3000 dollars pour louer un autre lieu. C'est Madame Lee, la propriétaire d'un restaurant chinois, qui paie la location du théâtre grâce à Tori.

programme.title: Victorious FR: Une chaleur infernale
programme.desc: Une vague de chaleur touche Los Angeles et la bande décide d'aller à la plage dans la caravane de Beck. Mais une fois à l'intérieur, ils se retrouvent coincés... Et la température continue de grimper...

programme.title: Victorious FR: Connexion en Plein Ciel
programme.desc: Tori rentre en avion à Los Angeles. Celui-ci a beaucoup de retard et Tori doit faire d'urgence un devoir pour le lendemain matin. Elle décide alors de le faire via tchat avec André, Cat et Beck, depuis l'avion.

programme.title: Victorious FR: Freak the Freak Out, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Trina se fait enlever les dents de sagesse et Tori est chargée de s'occuper d'elle pendant que ses parents sont partis en weekend.

programme.title: Don't Give Up The Ship
programme.desc: New bridegroom called to D.C. to explain what happened to a navy destroyer escort gone since WWII.

programme.title: Who's Minding The Store?
programme.desc: An incompetent young man is given a job in a department store by his girlfriend's mother, who hopes to put an end to their romance.

programme.title: The Errand Boy
programme.desc: Morty S. Tashman, under the guise of studio mail clerk, is to roam the lot and then report back to the boss with any questionable or dishonest activities. But virtually all of the shenanigans and escapades Morty uncovers are ones of his own doing!

programme.title: Black Hawk Down
programme.desc: Based on the true story of a war waged in Mogadishu by the high-tech Black Hawk helicopters and the US Army Rangers and Deltas.

programme.title: Pompeii
programme.desc: Set in 79 A.D., POMPEII tells the epic story of Milo, a slave-turned-invincible gladiator who finds himself in a race against time to save his true love, Cassia, the beautiful daughter of a wealthy merchant.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: They
programme.desc: Lifelong friends begin experiencing the "night terrors" that plagued them as children, convincing them that a supernatural force is pursuing them.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula II: Ascension
programme.desc: In this follow up to the hit horror film Wes Craven's Dracula 2000, a group of medical students discover the body of the infamous count.

programme.title: A Soldier's Story
programme.desc: A fine drama set during World War II, in which a black military attorney investigates the death of a black sergeant. The lawyer eventually discovers that the sergeant was both ashamed of his own culture and virulently hated by his men.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Denzel Washington returns to one of his signature roles in the first sequel of his career. Robert McCall serves unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed – but how far will he go when it is someone he loves?

programme.title: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

programme.title: Sakra
programme.desc: Starring & directed by international action star Donnie Yen—When a respected martial artist is accused of murder, he goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origin story and the unknown enemies working to destroy him.

programme.title: Silat Warriors: Deed of Death
programme.desc: When a young gambler runs afoul of the gang rigging a local betting ring, his luck soon runs out. When they show up to collect, he faces dire consequences, and his siblings must fight for their land and their lives—before time runs out.

programme.title: Shadow Master
programme.desc: After being slain by a group of criminals, a man is reborn with animal-like superpowers and makes it his mission to right the wrongs of his city.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality
programme.desc: International screen sensation Sandra Bullock stars as an FBI agent who goes undercover as a beauty contestant to capture a terrorist in this hilarious action-comedy.

programme.title: The Bounty Hunter (2010)
programme.desc: Milo is a bounty hunter who gets his dream job when he is assigned to track down his bail-jumping reporter ex-wife. When she gives him the slip so she can chase a lead on a murder cover-up, Milo realizes that nothing ever goes smoothly with her.

programme.title: Code Name: The Cleaner
programme.desc: Cedric the Entertainer brings the funny as Jake Rodgers, a janitor in a dirty world who becomes our only hope! He might have no memory after being assaulted by mysterious villains, but nothing can stop the spirit of this Regular Joe.

programme.title: The Ex
programme.desc: After getting fired, a man winds up working for his wife's father while she takes care of the baby.

programme.title: I Love You, Man
programme.desc: A friendless groom-to-be meets the ultimate dude and the two begin a "bro-mance" which takes male-bonding to hilarious new heights that will keep you laughing to the end.

programme.title: This Is 40
programme.desc: From the director of Knocked Up comes a comedic look at an American family as one couple (Paul Rudd and Leslie Mann) tries to balance romance, parenting, and children in their own hilarious ways.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: The Virgin Suicides
programme.desc: In the mid-1970s, in a Michigan community, live the Lisbon sisters, five teenagers who have bewitched a group of neighborhood boys.

programme.title: Dream Scenario
programme.desc: A hapless family man (Nicolas Cage) finds his life turned upside down when millions of strangers suddenly see him in their dreams and his newfound stardom takes a nightmarish turn. A wickedly entertaining comedy from producer Ari Aster.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: Revisionist western about fallen preacher Shay, who guns down his wife Raysha for running off with another man. Wandering, he meets single mom Laurie. However, helpless sheriff Scoby wants Shay to help him fight the villainous Clavers.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Attack the Block
programme.desc: ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick-ass heroes.

programme.title: Rush Hour
programme.desc: The fastest hands in the East meet the biggest mouth in the West when legendary martial arts daredevil Jackie Chan teams with comedic powerhouse Chris Tucker in Rush Hour.

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: While vacationing together in Hong Kong, fast-talking LAPD Detective Carter and Hong Kong Police Inspector Lee investigate when a bomb explodes in the American embassy.

programme.title: While She Was Out
programme.desc: Della (Academy-Award®-winner Kim Basinger), a suburban housewife, is hell-bent on survival as she is mercilessly stalked by a group of teenage thugs led by a manipulative psychopath (Luke Haas of WITNESS).

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: The Babadook
programme.desc: In this terrifying thriller, a mother must protect her son from an evil, supernatural entity that has escaped the pages of a children's book and is lurking in their home.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin' Rydell High for a whole new term! It's 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there's a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
programme.desc: Loner Zack Mayo (Richard Gere) enters Officer Candidate School to become a Navy pilot, and in thirteen torturous weeks, he learns the importance of discipline, love, and friendship.

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: With brothers Mikey and Brand's house slated for demolition by greedy developers, the boys' only hope lies in finding a long-lost treasure. They uncover a treasure map and, with their friends, descend to a subterranean sea and an abandoned galleon.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly 20 years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was canceled, the cast is asked for help by an alien species to save the universe.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: When Jack Deebs was behind bars he found escape by creating Cool World, a cartoon series featuring a vixen named Holli Would. The flesh proves weaker than ink, however, as Holli takes human form in Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Phantom
programme.desc: The story begins as an expedition lands on the island of Bengalla, seeking the Skulls of Touganda. Believed to harness an energy force of power, they could spell disaster for mankind.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Ladies Man (2000)
programme.desc: Leon loses his radio show because of his X-rated on-air comments. He then gets a letter from a former flame promising him a lifetime of wealth and happiness, and things start looking up!

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: Flirting with Disaster
programme.desc: From the director of AMERICAN HUSTLE and SILVER LININGS PLAYBOOK comes this clever comedy with an all-star cast that examines dysfunctions of modern family life.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head Do America
programme.desc: When their TV is stolen, Beavis and Butt-head hit the road in a hilarious film debut that proves what millions of fans already know: Beavis and Butt-head RULE!

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

programme.title: A Bridge Too Far
programme.desc: With an all-star cast that includes Sean Connery, Anthony Hopkins, Laurence Olivier, Gene Hackman and Robert Redford, this epic WW II drama recreates Operation Market Garden, an ambitious plan to hasten the end of WW II that ended in disaster.

programme.title: Force 10 From Navarone
programme.desc: A group of allied commandos on a mission against the 3rd Reich has orders to blow a giant dam in order to crush a strategic bridge held by the Nazis.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dynamite
programme.desc: The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

programme.title: Equilibrium
programme.desc: In the future, mankind has outlawed the things that trigger emotion-literature, music, and art. To uphold the law, a special breed of police is assigned to eliminate all transgressors. Christian Bale stars in this awesome high-tech action thriller.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.

programme.title: Hellboy (2004)
programme.desc: Born in the flames of hell and brought to Earth, Hellboy was rescued from sinister forces by the benevolent Dr. Broom, who raised him to be a hero. Hellboy stands as the key line of defense against an evil madman who seeks to destroy mankind.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night
programme.desc: Josh Hartnett (The Black Dahlia, Pearl Harbor) crosses over to the dark side in this bone-chilling adaptation of the cult-hit graphic novel, brought to the screen in all its demonic glory.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night: Dark Days
programme.desc: Almost a year has passed since vampires decimated Barrow, Alaska’s population. Stella, mourning her husband’s murder, has been traveling the world trying to convince others that vampires exist.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Latency
programme.desc: An agoraphobic gamer agrees to test new equipment that uses AI to interpret the electrical activity of her brain. Soon, the line between reality and her subconscious starts to blur as she wonders if the device is serving a sinister force.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: A mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling on a collision course toward earth.

programme.title: Source Code

programme.title: The Errand Boy
programme.desc: Morty S. Tashman, under the guise of studio mail clerk, is to roam the lot and then report back to the boss with any questionable or dishonest activities. But virtually all of the shenanigans and escapades Morty uncovers are ones of his own doing!

programme.title: The Nutty Professor
programme.desc: Jerry Lewis directed, co-wrote and starred in this riotously funny movie that set a new standard for screen comedy and inspired the hit remake.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: Frank Sinatra, Laurence Harvey, Janet Leigh, and Angela Lansbury headline an all-star cast in this daring thriller rife with political intrigue, mental manipulation, and a diabolical plot that may lead to the highest levels of the government.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: Throughout time, men have waged war. Some for power, some for glory, some for honor ... and some for love.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner portrays the leader of a U.S. bomb-defusing squad in Iraq in this fierce tale of war. The film won 6 Oscars, including the 2009 Best Picture and Best Director (Kathryn Bigelow).

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula II: Ascension
programme.desc: In this follow up to the hit horror film Wes Craven's Dracula 2000, a group of medical students discover the body of the infamous count.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula III: Legacy
programme.desc: The third film in Wes Craven Presents Dracula 2000 series concludes with the dreaded Dracula leading vampire hunters Father and Luke back to Eastern Europe and a country plagued by civil war.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night
programme.desc: Josh Hartnett (The Black Dahlia, Pearl Harbor) crosses over to the dark side in this bone-chilling adaptation of the cult-hit graphic novel, brought to the screen in all its demonic glory.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Denzel Washington returns to one of his signature roles in the first sequel of his career. Robert McCall serves unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed – but how far will he go when it is someone he loves?

programme.title: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Miami cops Will Smith and Martin Lawrence are two loose cannons who tear up the Sunshine State in search of stolen drugs. Co-starring Tea Leoni. Explosive direction by Michael Bay (Armageddon).

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: The action and comedy never stop when Martin Lawrence and Will Smith reunite as out-of-control, trash-talking buddy cops. Bullets fly, cars crash, and laughs explode as they pursue a whacked-out drug lord from the streets of Miami to the barrios of Cuba.

programme.title: Silat Warriors: Deed of Death
programme.desc: When a young gambler runs afoul of the gang rigging a local betting ring, his luck soon runs out. When they show up to collect, he faces dire consequences, and his siblings must fight for their land and their lives—before time runs out.

programme.title: Shadow Master
programme.desc: After being slain by a group of criminals, a man is reborn with animal-like superpowers and makes it his mission to right the wrongs of his city.

programme.title: The Game Changer
programme.desc: In Shanghai, two escaped prisoners rise to power in the Green Gang under boss Mr. Tang. But betrayal threatens to upend their alliance and control over the city's underworld.

programme.title: Code Name: The Cleaner
programme.desc: Cedric the Entertainer brings the funny as Jake Rodgers, a janitor in a dirty world who becomes our only hope! He might have no memory after being assaulted by mysterious villains, but nothing can stop the spirit of this Regular Joe.

programme.title: Like a Boss
programme.desc: Best friends, Mia and Mel (Tiffany Haddish & Rose Byrne), are running their own cosmetics company when a villainous beauty mogul (Salma Hayek) conspires to steal it. Mia and Mel must stick together and fight to reclaim their company.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality
programme.desc: International screen sensation Sandra Bullock stars as an FBI agent who goes undercover as a beauty contestant to capture a terrorist in this hilarious action-comedy.

programme.title: This Is 40
programme.desc: From the director of Knocked Up comes a comedic look at an American family as one couple (Paul Rudd and Leslie Mann) tries to balance romance, parenting, and children in their own hilarious ways.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It’s free, he’s got a great room, and Mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

programme.title: The Family Stone
programme.desc: A comic story about the annual holiday gathering of a New England family, the Stones.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: The Virgin Suicides
programme.desc: In the mid-1970s, in a Michigan community, live the Lisbon sisters, five teenagers who have bewitched a group of neighborhood boys.

programme.title: Dream Scenario
programme.desc: A hapless family man (Nicolas Cage) finds his life turned upside down when millions of strangers suddenly see him in their dreams and his newfound stardom takes a nightmarish turn. A wickedly entertaining comedy from producer Ari Aster.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama, which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck, tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Winner of 2 Academy Awards, including Best Original Screenplay. With the help of his mentor, a slave-turned-bounty hunter sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse

programme.title: The Brink
programme.desc: Reckless police inspector Tung is on a mission to crack down on criminal Shing's gold smuggling scheme. As Tung continues his manhunt, he discovers Shing's involvement with triad boss Blackie, who hides on a casino cruise ship on the high seas.

programme.title: Striking Rescue
programme.desc: Tony Jaa is in top form as Bai An, a muay thai expert seeking revenge against the men who brutally murdered his wife and child. Jaa dominates the screen with powerful flying knees and elbows, proving he’s still one of the best there is.

programme.title: The Guillotines
programme.desc: A secret brotherhood of assassins, once favored by the Emperor, is exiled and hunted with firearms that challenge the power of their cold steel.

programme.title: 11 Rebels
programme.desc: In the final days of the samurai, 11 condemned warriors are offered redemption—defend a mountain pass or die forgotten. Led by ex-samurai, Tatsukoro (Takayuki Yamada), they face a brutal siege in a last stand of steel, honor, and blood.

programme.title: Code Name: The Cleaner
programme.desc: Cedric the Entertainer brings the funny as Jake Rodgers, a janitor in a dirty world who becomes our only hope! He might have no memory after being assaulted by mysterious villains, but nothing can stop the spirit of this Regular Joe.

programme.title: Like a Boss
programme.desc: Best friends, Mia and Mel (Tiffany Haddish & Rose Byrne), are running their own cosmetics company when a villainous beauty mogul (Salma Hayek) conspires to steal it. Mia and Mel must stick together and fight to reclaim their company.

programme.title: Easy Money
programme.desc: In order to collect a $10-million inheritance, a working-class slob has one year to give up all of his bad habits...drinking, overeating, smoking and gambling.

programme.title: The Ugly Truth
programme.desc: A romantically challenged TV producer's search for Mr. Perfect has left her hopelessly single. She's in for a rude awakening when her boss teams her with Mike Chadway, a hardcore TV personality who promises to spill the ugly truth about romance.

programme.title: Think Like a Man
programme.desc: Four friends conspire to turn the tables on their women when they discover the ladies have been using Steve Harvey's relationship advice against them.

programme.title: Think Like a Man Too
programme.desc: All the couples are back for a wedding in Las Vegas, but plans for a romantic weekend go awry when their various misadventures get them into some compromising situations that threaten to derail the big event.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama, which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck, tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Slow West
programme.desc: A bounty hunter (Michael Fassbender) keeps his true motive a secret from the naïve Scottish teenager (Kodi Smit-McPhee) he's offered to serve as bodyguard and guide while the youth searches for his beloved in 1800s Colorado.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
programme.desc: The greatest American Heroes are back, and they've been set up to take the fall for a heinous crime they didn't commit. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) leads a new team (including Channing Tatum and Bruce Willis) on this high-octane adventure.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: GoodFellas
programme.desc: Director Martin Scorsese exposes the fascinating, mysterious, and violent underworld of New York's Mafia families through the life of insider Henry Hill.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: The Boondock Saints
programme.desc: Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes, wiping out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

programme.title: Woodshock
programme.desc: A haunted young woman spirals into confusion and chaos after she falls under the spell of a potent reality-altering drug.

programme.title: Eden Lake
programme.desc: A young couple travels to a remote lake quarry in England, only to fend off a group of teenage hoods.

programme.title: While She Was Out
programme.desc: Della (Academy-Award®-winner Kim Basinger), a suburban housewife, is hell-bent on survival as she is mercilessly stalked by a group of teenage thugs led by a manipulative psychopath (Luke Haas of WITNESS).

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: A single mother and her two sons discover much more than they anticipated in this visually stunning blend of hip humor, horror, and rock 'n' roll about the most compelling group of contemporary vampires ever to put fang to vein.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: Shaun is content to be a bright but unfocused surf slacker until the day he discovers a novel by acclaimed author Martin Skinner. Inspired, he suddenly leaves Orange County to study creative writing at Stanford University.

programme.title: Hot Rod
programme.desc: A comedy about a stunt man who’s never successfully landed a jump without wiping out and his attempt to master the biggest stunt of his life.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze plays a ghost who teams with a psychic (Whoopi Goldberg) to uncover the truth behind his murder — and to rescue his sweetheart (Demi Moore) from a similar fate.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: After being separated by loss, a young couple discovers an eternal connection and a love that is infinite.

programme.title: Ghost Town (2008)
programme.desc: A spirited romantic comedy, Ghost Town is the story of Bertram Pincus, a cranky Manhattan dentist who develops the unwelcome ability to see dead people.

programme.title: The Pelican Brief
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Julia Roberts and Denzel Washington star in this thriller about a young law student whose theory about the recent deaths of two Supreme Court justices embroils her in a web of greed, corruption, and murder.

programme.title: The Client
programme.desc: The Mafia wants to keep 11-year-old Mark Sway quiet, and a federal prosecutor wants to learn exactly what he knows. So Mark finds a lawyer who's smart and tough, and she wants to help him. If he can only trust her…

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Murder on the Orient Express
programme.desc: Famous detective Hercule Poirot is on the Orient Express, but the train is caught in the snow. When one of the passengers is discovered murdered, Poirot immediately starts investigating.

programme.title: The Duellists
programme.desc: Keith Carradine and Harvey Keitel star in this dramatic film about two officers in Napoleon’s army who violently confront each other in a series of duels.

programme.title: The Shootist
programme.desc: Afflicted with a terminal illness, John Bernard Books, the last of the legendary gunfighters, quietly returns to Carson City for medical attention from his old friend Dr. Hostetler.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D., and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earth's closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: Hellboy (2004)
programme.desc: Born in the flames of hell and brought to Earth, Hellboy was rescued from sinister forces by the benevolent Dr. Broom, who raised him to be a hero. Hellboy stands as the key line of defense against an evil madman who seeks to destroy mankind.

programme.title: Ex Machina
programme.desc: A young programmer (Domhnall Gleeson) at an internet company is chosen by a reclusive CEO (Oscar Isaac) to evaluate the capabilities and consciousness of a beautiful and sophisticated robot (Alicia Vikander).

programme.title: Renegade: Il terrorista

programme.title: Black Beard Projects
programme.desc: Primo tentativo di forgiare la lama per il progetto wakizashi. Il video mostra la forgiatura, la rettifica pre-tempra e il trattamento termico, ma purtroppo la lama si rompe.

programme.title: Black Beard Projects
programme.desc: Fabbricazione di una spada ispirata alla leggendaria lama col marchio dell'airone da "La Ruota del Tempo". Acciaio 1070, 97 cm totali, guardia in acciaio e manico in legno iroko con intarsi di aironi.

programme.title: Black Beard Projects
programme.desc: Restauro completo di una cesoia industriale da 350 kg: smontaggio, rimozione di ruggine e vernice con laser, affilatura delle lame, verniciatura, rimontaggio e test finale.

programme.title: Black Beard Projects
programme.desc: Creazione artigianale di Shalamayne, la leggendaria spada di Varian e Anduin Wrynn da World of Warcraft, realizzata in soli 10 giorni a grandezza naturale.

programme.title: Black Beard Projects
programme.desc: Creazione di una spada Xiphos in bronzo (90% rame, 10% stagno): fusione della lega, modellazione, stampo, colata, indurimento del filo e finitura con intarsio di stagno sulla guardia.

programme.title: Black Beard Projects
programme.desc: Realizzazione di un coltello da cucina in acciaio ad alto carbonio C70, con trattamento termico differenziale, manico in legno stabilizzato e fissaggio tradizionale giapponese a spina.

programme.title: Black Beard Projects
programme.desc: Realizzazione di un coltello da cucina in acciaio damasco (chiodi e polvere 1095) con manico in legno d'olivo, ebano e redheart. Nonostante un problema durante il trattamento termico, il progetto viene completato con successo.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 3, Episodio 8
programme.desc: Mentre Chummy si prepara ad accudire in casa la madre morente, Jenny si ritrova ad aiutarla. Mentre Shelagh e il dottor Turner attendono notizie dal Centro Adozioni, la donna dà il massimo iscrivendo il suo coro a un concorso.

programme.title: Call the Midwife: Christmas Special: Episodio 1
programme.desc: Prove in corso per il Concerto della Scuola Domenicale!

programme.title: Call the Midwife: Christmas Special: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Cynthia viene coinvolta in un caso che riguarda gli ex residenti di una clinica psichiatrica vittoriana.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 4, Episodio 3
programme.desc: Mentre Poplar è colpita da una misteriosa ondata di dissenteria, la vita della neomamma Marie Amos viene sconvolta dall'arresto del marito Tony.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 4, Episodio 4
programme.desc: Le levatrici affrontano una delle serate più impegnative che abbiano mai avuto, mentre Suor Winifred concentra i suoi sforzi sulle prostitute di Poplar.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 4, Episodio 5
programme.desc: La fede di Suor Julienne viene messa alla prova quando una madre rifiuta le medicine per il suo neonato.

programme.title: Andromeda: I legami che accecano
programme.desc: Dopo aver risposto a una chiamata di soccorso, l'equipaggio raccoglie il fratello di Beka, ora un Wayista, e il suo amico.

programme.title: Andromeda: Le sponde del Lete
programme.desc: Grazie a un buco nero Dylan riesce a comunicare con la sua ex compagna, 300 anni fa.

programme.title: Andromeda: Una rosa nelle ceneri
programme.desc: Dylan è prigioniero su un pianeta-prigione e deve trovare una via di fuga mentre l’equipaggio organizza il suo salvataggio.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tutto l'oceano del grande Nettuno
programme.desc: I Castaliani salgono a bordo dell'Andromeda per ultimare la costituzione del Nuovo Commonwealth. Quando il loro leader viene trovato morto, tutti i sospetti ricadono su Tyr.

programme.title: Andromeda: Le perle che erano i suoi occhi
programme.desc: Beka viene a sapere che l'ex socio in affari di suo padre è coinvolto nello spaccio di una droga che da forte dipendenza chiamata Flash.

programme.title: Andromeda: La matematica delle lacrime
programme.desc: L'Andromeda scopre la sua nave sorella, la Pax Magellanic. L'equipaggio a bordo della Pax ha 300 anni... ma non è invecchiato di un giorno.

programme.title: Abbasso l'amore - Down with Love
programme.desc: New York City .Il giornalista Catcher Block ottiene sempre quello che vuole. Ma quando incontra la donna che potrebbe essere della sua vita, la scrittrice di best seller Barbara Novak...

programme.title: Love on the Rise
programme.desc: Una panettiera scambia un ricco scapolo per un cameriere e i due si innamorano rapidamente, senza rendersi conto che l'azienda di lui sta cercando di sfrattare la sua panetteria.

programme.title: Crazy kind of love
programme.desc: Quando la famiglia Moon deve affrontare una nuova, inattesa gravidanza, i fragili equilibri domestici vengono completamente stravolti. Il padre scompare, la madre deve ritrovare la sua identità, e i figli adolescenti si ritrovano a crescere in fretta.

programme.title: Two Much - Uno Di Troppo
programme.desc: Art vive di espedienti vendendo quadri a vedove facoltose. Dopo un weekend con la ricca Betty, accetta di sposarla, ma si innamora della sorella Liz. Per conquistarla, inventa un fantomatico fratello gemello, dando vita a una girandola di equivoci.

programme.title: Cirque Du Soleil: Mondi lontani
programme.desc: Il fantastico viaggio di due giovani attraverso gli straordinari mondi da sogno del Cirque du Soleil per trovarsi l'un l'altro. Un'esperienza unica che unisce le migliori performances di sette degli spettacoli Cirque Du Soleil di Las Vegas.

programme.title: Uno spostato sotto tiro
programme.desc: Quella che doveva essere una fuga romantica si trasforma in una serie di disastri quando la fidanzata di Michael lo abbandona nel deserto, dove un adolescente gli ruba l'auto e viene preso in ostaggio durante una rapina al locale Sip and Zip.

programme.title: Stay - Nel Labirinto della Mente
programme.desc: La storia thriller di uno psichiatra e dei suoi febbrili tentativi di impedire a un paziente introverso di suicidarsi. Ma quest'ultimo nasconde misteri inquietanti e surreali

programme.title: Strade perdute
programme.desc: All'ingresso della propria casa lussuosa e asettica, Fred Madison scopre alcune videocassette che ritraggono lui e la moglie mentre dormono. L'ultimo video ricevuto li riprende mentre lui è intento a massacrare lei, ma purtroppo Fred non ricorda nulla.

programme.title: Twilight
programme.desc: La leggenda del cinema Paul Newman guida un brillante cast in questo poliziesco pieno di stelle e suspense.

programme.title: Stressati
programme.desc: Marco e Dado sono amici dai tempi del liceo e lavorano nella redazione di un giornale satirico. Dado ha successo con le donne mentre Marco ha molti problemi, fin quando non arrivano Adele e Maria a cambiare le loro vite.

programme.title: Alina
programme.desc: La contrabbandiera Alina incontra George. S'innamorano ma sono ostacolati dall'amante di lui e da un criminale infatuato di lei. Si susseguono una serie di pericolosissime vicende prima che i due possano provare a fuggire insieme.

programme.title: Una Banda Di Matti In Vacanza Premio
programme.desc: La scolaresca è composta da strampalati alunni di mezz'età. Tra loro ci sono: Carletto e il Barone Rosso. Il professor Federe ha in mente un trapianto per invertire i loro cervelli. Per organizzare l’operazione offre alla classe una vacanza premio.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Ricchi Ritorni?
programme.desc: Rich torna per confrontarsi con Les sull'essere stato licenziato. In un ultimo disperato tentativo, Rich individua ciò che pensa siano beni rubati. Se ha ragione sulla situazione, a Les sembrerà un salvatore.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: lo shock
programme.desc: Il nuovo schema monetario di Seth attira dure critiche da Ashley. Ma se funziona, potrebbe significare milioni per il negozio. Quindi, un cliente porta una sedia elettrica vintage che aiuta Rich a ottenere il favore di Les.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Storia da un milione di dollari
programme.desc: Les adora le belle storie, ma viene ingannato da un gruppo di venditori esperti? Seth e Ashley cercano di inchiodarlo al muro sulla sua intenzione di comprare, ma Les rimane fermo.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Amy è tornata
programme.desc: Seth è colto alla sprovvista quando Les riporta indietro l'ex dipendente Amy che sostiene li abbia fregati. Sebbene sia nota per la sua sfaldamento, accumula vendite meglio di chiunque altro nel negozio.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Scattato in contanti
programme.desc: Les compra rari cimeli rock che potrebbero valere un mucchio di soldi. Poi, quando un uomo viene sorpreso a cercare di vendere di nascosto l'anello della sua ragazza, lei prepara una punizione che non è mai stata vista prima nel negozio.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Bocca del motore
programme.desc: Les è tentato di infrangere la politica del negozio quando un cliente che parla velocemente lo inchioda al muro. Ma quando Seth interverrà, i soldi verranno tolti dal tavolo?

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Rapina a sangue freddo
programme.desc: Un cliente viene trovato nascosto in un frigorifero. Ashley giura che stava aspettando l'orario di chiusura per sgattaiolare fuori e derubarli.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Le spese folli di Les
programme.desc: Les sta distribuendo centinaia per una sfilata di oggetti che Seth e Ashley affermano essere inutili. Quando i ragazzi rivelano il suo retrobottega pieno di tutto, dalle Pontiac alle protesi, Les è completamente distrutto.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Birmano o sballato?
programme.desc: A Les viene presentato un vasetto di polvere d'oro che potrebbe valere migliaia, ma Ashley è convinta che non sia altro che un ombretto. Un test dell'acido esplosivo rivela la sua vera natura.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Avvocato su figlio
programme.desc: Un conflitto per una ricevuta falsa si trasforma in una guerra in piena regola alla finestra. Ma quando Les cerca di vedere il bluff del cliente, lei torna con un avvocato di Motor City che potrebbe far finire Les in acqua calda.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: La grande scommessa di Seth
programme.desc: Ashley sfida Seth a una competizione unica che mette il ragazzo d'oro sopra la sua testa. Se non può consegnare la merce, il mondo ascolterà l'unica cosa per cui ha combattuto per mantenere un segreto.

programme.title: Il Natale perfetto di Carol
programme.desc: When a fiercely independent pastry chef cautiously agrees to the big step of accompanying her hunky dream man home for the holidays, things quickly devolve as he reverts into a momma’s boy.

programme.title: Natale in Tre
programme.desc: Life-long best friends Sarah, Cat and Riley reunite in Sarah’s childhood home to cook up some Christmas magic and save the holidays for their families.

programme.title: I fantasmi del Natale passato
programme.desc: A woman with a serial “ghosting” problem on dating apps is told by a fortune teller that she must resolve her past and make amends with all of those she ghosted before Christmas or she is destined to never find true love.

programme.title: Tides
programme.desc: In un futuro non troppo lontano la Terra è stata colpita da una catastrofe globale. Una giovane astronauta si troverà a compiere una scelta che cambierà per sempre il destino del pianeta.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Giant Octopus
programme.desc: Nelle profondità del mare stanno succedendo degli eventi strani. La biologa marina Emma MacNeil viene inviata a indagare. Un enorme squalo preistorico e un polpo gigante sono stati risvegliati dal loro gelido sonno e hanno fame.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Mecha Shark
programme.desc: Quando un nuovo Mega Squalo minaccia l'umanità, il governo scatena l'arma top secret Mecha Shark per sconfiggere il mostro in una battaglia campale che minaccia il pianeta.

programme.title: Man from earth
programme.desc: Il party a sorpresa per il pensionamento del professor John Oldman si trasforma in un mistero quando l'uomo rivela ai suoi colleghi di essere in realtà un immortale che erra sulla terra da ormai 14 mila anni.

programme.title: Lavalantula
programme.desc: Una violenta eruzione vulcanica sulle montagne di Santa Monica dà vita a una serie di crateri da cui non esce solo lava incandescente, ma anche giganteschi ragni dotati della capacità di sputare fuoco.

programme.title: Legendary
programme.desc: L'archeologo Travis Preston parte per la Cina in seguito ad alcune misteriorse segnalazioni di avvistamenti. L'obiettivo della missione è quello di dimostrare l'esistenza di una mostruosa creatura preistorica, che sta scatenando il panico.

programme.title: Notti di terrore
programme.desc: Scienziato pazzo produce una lozione per attrarre pipistrelli giganti.

programme.title: Sartana nella valle degli avvoltoi
programme.desc: Sartana è sulle tracce di una banda che tenta di espatriare con un grosso quantitativo d'oro rubato all'esercito.

programme.title: Che botte ragazzi!
programme.desc: Un losco boss della città, Pat Barnes, ha sfruttato quasi tutti gli abitanti della città. Chi non cede alle sue richieste di solito finisce per morire. Barnes viene finalmente sconfitto da Shanghai Joe.

programme.title: Adios Cjamango
programme.desc: Le avventure di Cjamango e Peggy, due giovani sposi proprietari di un ranch che si battono per salvare la propria casa dalle grinfie di una compagnia ferroviaria decisa ad acquistare il loro terreno.

programme.title: Viva la muerte... tua!
programme.desc: Un autoproclamato principe russo, un bandito messicano e una giornalista irlandese radicale si alleano durante la rivoluzione messicana per cercare fortuna e notorietà.

programme.title: Avengers Grimm: Time Wars
programme.desc: Il sovrano degli Inferi, Tremotino, si nasconde, escogitando dei piani per conquistare la Terra una volta per tutte. Mentre gli Avengers Grimm combattono per fermarlo, scoprono rapidamente che non è dove si nasconde Tremotino, ma quando.

programme.title: Super Cyclone
programme.desc: Quando un superciclone minaccia l'intera costa orientale americana, una meteorologa solitaria e un ingegnere petrolifero devono combattere gli elementi per fermare la minaccia.

programme.title: Mamma Ho Perso il Cane
programme.desc: Quando una famiglia visita la casa della nonna la vigilia di Natale, lascia il cane a casa da solo. E quando i ladri cercano di prendere i regali da sotto l'albero, il cane deve usare tutti i trucchi che conosce per fermarli.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Kali Seconda Parte
programme.desc: Magnus inizia a mettere insieme i dettagli scioccanti che circondano le visioni di Will su Kali, la sua malattia e la sua connessione con il più potente Anormale sulla Terra.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Kali Terza Parte
programme.desc: L'apertura della terza stagione trova la squadra del Santuario che cerca disperatamente di trovare un modo per raggiungere Kali per prevenire catastrofi e disastri globali.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Ritorno Dall'Aldila
programme.desc: Will soffre di amnesia riguardo agli eventi della sua esperienza di pre-morte, ma alcuni visitatori indesiderati diventano intenzionati a scoprire cosa è bloccato nella sua memoria.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Rapina In Banca
programme.desc: La squadra va in missione di routine per recuperare un Anormale e portarlo al sicuro. Ma la missione diventa tutt'altro che di routine quando sono costretti a mettere in scena una rapina in banca per proteggere il pubblico dai danni.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Scia Di Sangue
programme.desc: La squadra riceve una criptica chiamata di soccorso che potrebbe provenire solo da una persona... Nikola Tesla.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Il Supereroe 2: La Freccia Spezzata
programme.desc: Kate acquisisce abilità da supereroe quando un Anormale si attacca a lei per proteggerla.

programme.title: Un Amante Tradito
programme.desc: Cinque anni dopo che suo figlio è stato ucciso, Tess Ford è pronta a vivere di nuovo. Ma una storia d'amore di una notte con un bel soldato riporta la sua vita nel caos mentre l'attrazione del giovane si rivela un'ossessione spaventosa.

programme.title: Una Vicina Quasi Perfetta
programme.desc: Lo stalker esiste solo nell'immaginazione di Grace Winston, una donna che uccide il marito e poi usa il personaggio immaginario per convincere il suo vicino ad "amarla e proteggerla"!

programme.title: Amore e Ossessione
programme.desc: Dopo l’omicidio del suo fidanzato Megan si trasferisce per ricostruirsi una vita, inseguita dall'ex collega di lavoro Lloyd. Quando scopre che Megan ha un nuovo fidanzato, Lloyd pensa di trattarlo nello stesso modo in cui ha trattato il suo ex fidanzato.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: La polizia deve trovare al più presto un serial killer che terrorizza una piccola città del Texas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Thriller Politico
programme.desc: Nel 2006, la politica del Nevada Kathy Augustine morì misteriosamente in un’accanita campagna di rielezione e il medico legale non riuscì né ad individuare la causa di morte né a spiegare le piccole ferite da puntura scoperte durante l'autopsia.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Servizi Funebri
programme.desc: Nel 2002, l’impresario funebre Lonnie Turner Sr. fu trovato colpito a morte. Il figlio Lonnie Jr. diventò il primo sospettato, specie dopo che si scoprì che l'omicidio venne commesso con la sua pistola. Tuttavia, aveva un alibi per l'ora del delitto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ribellione Mortale
programme.desc: Anche se la loro figlia era già scappata, tornava sempre. I suoi genitori erano sicuri che questa volta non sarebbe stato diverso, ma si sbagliavano.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Critica Costruttiva
programme.desc: Nel 2000, il capocantiere Darrell North fu trovato morto nel suo rimorchio a Ft. Vale, Texas. Quando gli inquirenti arrivarono, scoprirono che era stato accoltellato 46 volte, rivelando un rapporto personale tra la vittima e l'aggressore.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Favola di Cenerentola
programme.desc: La vittima fu violentata e pugnalata a morte sulla spiaggia. Vicino al corpo venne ritrovato un paio di scarpe da tennis maschili. La polizia era sicura che se avesse trovato l'uomo delle scarpe, avrebbe trovato anche chi aveva commesso il delitto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Candidato per Omicidio
programme.desc: Il 12 maggio 1994, Crystal Perry fu brutalmente assassinata nella sua casa a Bridgton, nel Maine. Michael Hutchinson, 32 anni, fu dichiarato colpevole di omicidio.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Scarsa Manutenzione
programme.desc: Nel 2008, l’universitaria Jenna Verhaalen fu trovata morta nel suo appartamento a Bryan, in Texas, e le emorragie petecchiali nei suoi occhi indicavano che era stata strangolata.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: La donna muore. L'uomo sopravvive dopo essere stato colpito quattro volte.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: La vittima aveva ingerito una grande quantità di cianuro.

programme.title: Questa è la vita
programme.desc: Totò, Aldo Fabrizi e Walter Chiari in una splendida commedia a epidosi tratta dalle novelle di Pirandello, diretta da geniali registi: La Giara (Giorgio Pàstina), Il Ventaglino (Mario Soldati), La Patente (Luigi Zampa) e Marsina Stretta (Aldo Fabrizi).

programme.title: Totò Story
programme.desc: Una grande raccolta di nove episodi tratti dalle pellicole più amate del grande Totò.

programme.title: Racconti Romani
programme.desc: Uscito dal carcere di Regina Coeli, Alvaro riprende il suo ruolo di "leader" del quartiere. Una Roma di fine anni '50 nel classico con Totò, la splendida Silvana Pampanini e il grande Vittorio De Sica.

programme.desc: Gli Immortali è il canale dedicato ai giganti del cinema d'azione: un vero e proprio campo di battaglia dove le più grandi star del genere si scontrano attraverso i loro film più iconici.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Il volto del terrore
