programme.title: iCarly: Hubert Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Lur Lewbert"-sketsj går helt galt og skader Carlys irriterende portvakt. Gjengen pleier ham inntil Freddies mor tar over. Men når kærligheten begynner å blomstre, må de sette en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Pie
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Spencer tar med Freddie til deres yndlingskonditori, finner de ut at eieren er død. Men enda verre er det at oppskriftene hans kanskje er gått tapt for alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: Jul
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å pifte opp julen med et utradisjonelt tre, kommer Spencer til å sette fyr på alle Carlys gaver. Fortvilet ønsker hun seg at hun hadde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kysset
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortelle Carly at han aldri har kysset en jente, og avslører hemmeligheten hans på netshowet. Gibby og Carly trener Spencer til utttaket for det lokale, profesjonelle fotballaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Bilbråk
programme.desc: Gjengen holder en konkurranse på iCarly, og premien er en ny bil fra en lokal forhandler. Etter at Nevel vinner, oppdager barna at forhandleren ikke visste noe om konkurransen eller bilen de skulle ha donert bort som premie.

programme.title: iCarly: Fred

programme.title: iCarly: Dobbelt opp

programme.title: iCarly: Om hva for noe?

programme.desc: Heidi digger singellivet, helt til hun blir sjalu når hun ser Spencer sammen med andre jenter. Whitney ber om Laurens hjelp ved Moteuken i LA, og åpner dermed nye dører for Lauren og hennes karriere.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Roommate
programme.desc: Med Spencer ute av bildet, prøver Heidi en siste gang å bli venner med Lauren igjen. Når Audrina begynner å være mer sammen med Heidi og Justin, spør Lauren seg selv om de egentlig bør fortsette å bo sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: En gammel flamme blusser opp når Stephen Coletti dukker opp igjen i Laurens liv. Heidi prøver å hindre Stephanie i å komme på Laurens innflytningsfest.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: iCarly: Gjenforening med Missy

programme.desc: Når Sam og Freddie begge to vinner konkurransen for skolens beste skap, slir de nødt til å dele skap. Carly ber Spencer gi henne timer i billedkunst.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly utdelingen

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillinger

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 2

programme.title: iCarly: iKamp mot Dingo
programme.desc: Dingo-kanalen har stjålet idéer fra iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer drar til Dingos Studio for å fortelle manusforfatterne hva de mener om det.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg tror de kysset
programme.desc: Da Sam kommer til å avsløre overfor Carly at hun og Freddie smugkysset, konfronterer Carly dem med hvorfor de ikke fortalte henne om det. Og Spencer underviser fanger i billedkunst i fengselet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokkekamp
programme.desc: Når Carl, Sam og Freddie vinner over en berømt tv-kokk i en matlagningskonkurranse, vil ikke kokken lage mat mer og nekter å komme ut av soverommet sitt. Spencer prøver å oppfylle en fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: iCarly: Rektor kampen
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie får rektor Franklin sparket, overtar miss Briggs og mr. Howard ledelsen og innfører strenge regler. Og Spencer leier en gammel rodeostjerne til å lære ham å ri på en mekanisk okse.

programme.title: iCarly: iSpeed Date
programme.desc: Så mange gutter dukker opp til 'ta Carly med på fest'-konkurransen, at Carly, Sam og Freddie må benytte speed-dating for å møte dem alle sammen. Spencer følger et merkelig treningsprogram fra en ny app.

programme.desc: Freddie behöver spendera tid med bara killar, så han följer med Spencer på fäktning. Freddie är en naturbegåvning, men saker och ting blir komplicerade när Spencer får honom involverad i en match mot den fantastiske Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en dejt
programme.desc: När deras vän Gibby är för blyg för att bjuda ut en tjej han gillar, bestämmer sig gänget för att göra honom och föremålet för hans kärlek till tävlande i ett "Vinn en dejt"-inslag i sin webbshow.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutations-situationen
programme.desc: När Shredder slår sig samman med Kraang för att få en leverans med mutagen så får Sköldpaddorna större problem än väntat, vilket till och med utmanar deras vänskap med April.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Följ ledaren
programme.desc: När Sköldpaddorna möter Shredders senaste hot, en armé av Fot-robotsoldater, så tillfångatar Karai Leonardo och tvingar honom att slåss mot de nya och förbättrade ninjorna, som snabbt anpassar sig till varje teknik han använder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Ekorrmonstren invaderar
programme.desc: Medan de är ute och letar efter mutagenbehållare så hittar Sköldpaddorna en muterad ekorre de tar hem till lyan. När den börjar multiplicera sig så tvingas bröderna jaga och fånga in ekorr-mutanterna innan de når ytan och staden.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutagenmannen är lös
programme.desc: Donatello gör ändlösa mutagen-experiment i ett försök att hitta ett botemedel åt Aprils muterade far. Tyvärr så utsätter det April för fara ifrån ett nytt hot: Mutagen-mannen!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mikey frår skal-akne
programme.desc: Michelangelo är trött på att känna sig som minstingen i gänget. Men när han leker runt med lite mutagen råkar han dra på sig en farlig infektion som snabbt muterar utom kontroll.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Måltavla: April O'Neil
programme.desc: April försöker uppehålla ett vanligt tonårsliv, men när Karai börjar jaga efter henne igen, så inser April att hon kanske blir tvungen att även försätta sin nye vän Casey Jones i fara.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Slash dyker upp
programme.desc: Sköldpaddorna finner sig plötsligt jagade av en annan muterad sköldpadda vid namn Slash, som har en personlig vendetta med bröderna.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Kraangs konspiration
programme.desc: April känner sig lämnad utanför och insisterar på att få följa med sköldpaddorna på ett uppdrag till TCRI, där de får en chockerande nyhet angående Aprils förflutna.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Den gode, den onde och Casey Jones
programme.desc: Efter att ha stött på både mutanter och ninjor så bestämmer sig Casey Jones för att ta sig an 'den rena ondskan' ensam. Men när han möter Raphael så måste de båda sätta sina egna högtflygande känslor åt sidan och samarbeta mot en gemensam fiende.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Grottsvampen
programme.desc: En muterad svamp sprider sig i kloakerna, vilken tvingar Sköldpaddorna och April att uppleva sin största skräck medan Leo tvingas möta sin, att förlora sina bröder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Metalhead 2.0
programme.desc: När Donnie uppgraderar Metalheads artificiella intelligens så måste han bestämma sig för ifall han kan lita på en självtänkande Metalhead, eller ifall han skapat en ny fiende.

programme.desc: Coverage, reporting and storytelling from CBS News and Stations; a look at how news coverage comes together.

programme.title: Art of the Heist: Chasing Cezanne
programme.desc: Nearly thirty years ago seven paintings, including a priceless Cezanne, were stolen from a private collection in America. As the years passed, Michael Bakwin, who owned the paintings, though he would never get see his precious Cezanne again.

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: Den sanna historien om den mäktige filmmogulen Harvey Weinsteins spektakulära uppgång och fall avslöjar hur han skaffar och sen utnyttjar sin makt i årtionden.

programme.title: The Battle for the Baltic Sea
programme.desc: The documentary delves deep into the extraordinary history of Hedvig Sophia. And after decades of investigation, archaeologists can finally close the case “Ostseewrack [wreck of the Baltic sea]”.

programme.title: Art of the Heist: The Trail of Moche Gold
programme.desc: The looting of a gold headdress from an ancient tomb in northern Peru is recounted.

programme.title: On the Case: Followed Home
programme.desc: A mother of three is found shot to death inside the trunk of her car, just steps from her home.

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer Among Friends
programme.desc: When a teenager is found savagely murdered, police must retrace her last steps alive to identify her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Twice Is No Accident
programme.desc: When Fran Smith mysteriously disappears her sister and daughter mount their own investigation... What they uncover sends police on a cross country man hunt for a killer.

programme.title: On the Case: A Mother's Nightmare
programme.desc: A young boy is murdered in his bed in the middle of the night. Police suspect the child's mother. Over the next 9 years there will be accusations, a confession and a conviction but will justice be served?

programme.title: On the Case: Broken Trust
programme.desc: When a young girl vanishes on the way home from school, her family and police are sent on a tormenting search for answers.

programme.title: On the Case: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A small town hair dresser is found beaten and strangled in her beauty salon. After the investigation goes cold, an act of conscience cracks the case.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Buffalo Scores
programme.desc: Buffalo scores the charter of a lifetime when they're asked to transport the Stanley Cup on a tour of the North. Cup fever spreads quickly around Buffalo, and for Mikey, what begins as an innocent love for this hockey icon soon becomes an obsession.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Special Delivery
programme.desc: Chief Pilot Arnie lands the DC-3 on a homemade sand strip at a remote lodge. Electra expert Chuck goes one-on-one with a stubborn power unit, and Rod's wife Sasha goes into labour with the newest member of the McBryan family.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Yukon
programme.desc: When thunderstorms and a shaking engine threaten a DC-3 charter to Whitehorse, Joe pulls out all the stops to get the passengers to their destination.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: British Invasion
programme.desc: oe and Mikey head off to Coventry, England to navigate the potential purchase of an Electra turboprop to add to Buffalo's fleet of fire-fighting tanker planes.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Arnie Calls It
programme.desc: While training waterbomber captains for the upcoming fire-fighting season, Chief Pilot Arnie makes a surprising decision. AJ becomes a DC-4 captain and ponders whether to accept a promotion.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under New Management
programme.desc: Joe hires outsider Duane Hicks to help Buffalo navigate the future and coach Mikey. Gord and Sean's DC-3 delivery mission to the High Arctic goes awry when blizzard conditions and a broken oil cooler force an emergency landing.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Jean-Raymond Blatti Case
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written \"DIRTY RAPIST\".

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Willy Pomonti Case
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris. It soon becomes clear that the man has been tortured prior to death.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Strange Hanging - Chantal Ternik Case
programme.desc: On April 3th 2003, Chantal Ternik, a 48 year old housewife, is discovered hanged in her house of Sanary-sur-Mer, in Var.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Françoise Desnoue Case
programme.desc: On the evening of August 30st 2013, in a small village of Bougrogne, Éric Desnoue, 52 years old, reports his wife missing to the police. Did Françoise Desnoue run away? Or did she reattempt to kill herself?

programme.title: The Nanny: Christmas Episode

programme.title: The Nanny: Personal Business

programme.title: The Nanny: The Nanny-In-Law
programme.desc: Fran contends with Maxwell's old nanny.

programme.title: The Nanny: A Plot For Nanny
programme.desc: Fran's birthday gift leads to a date with a handsome mortician.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Show Must Go On
programme.desc: Fran and Maxwell clash over Grace's school pageant.

programme.title: The Nanny: Maggie The Model
programme.desc: Chloe Simpson, a 1960s supermodel, re-enters ex-flame Maxwell's life, turning the Sheffield household upside down and interfering with the relationship between Fran and Maggie.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Family Plumbing
programme.desc: Maxwell reveals he has a double standard when it comes to his children and the opposite sex.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Egg and I
programme.desc: Steve returns to try and reclaim his estranged wife unaware that she has remarried to a younger man.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Psychic Avengers
programme.desc: Al is a broken man after the Bundys can no longer afford to buy a weekly TV Guide. When Jefferson arrives at their house with a fistful of cash, Al discovers that he has been running a psychic phone scam called "Madame Zelda."

programme.title: Våra värsta år: My Dinner with Anthrax
programme.desc: It's Al and Peggy's 20th wedding anniversary, but Peggy only wants one thing from Al....S-E-X. Meanwhile, Kelly and Bud win the "My Dinner With Anthrax" contest which means a house party for the thrash metal band.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: High I.Q.
programme.desc: An invitation to join the high intelligence Alpha club, is issued to Kelly and not Bud. When they discover the real reason behind the gathering, Kelly and Bud decide to handle things with the usual Bundy charm (and violence).

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Teacher Pets
programme.desc: Bud's belief that his 40-year-old teacher is romantic interested in him is greeted by laughter from everyone. But another student smells the smoke and wants the fire for herself.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Goodbye Girl
programme.desc: When Kelly's modeling school closes down, she gets a new job as a greeter at the TV World theme park. When this is threatened by her low performance ratings, Kelly is moved into Commercial Land where she plays "the Verminator" who hunts down roaches.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Gas Station Show
programme.desc: When Al can't pay his bill at the gas station, he is forced to don a uniform and work at the station. He spends the day being hounded by motorists, as well as Peg and the kids.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: England Show - Pt 1
programme.desc: Lower Uncton, England 1653-- Seamus McBundy makes the mistake of insulting a witch who casts an evil spell upon the land, shading the town in darkness forever--as long as a male Bundy lives.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: England Show - Pt 2
programme.desc: The Bundys delight in their comped trip to England, spending here and there. All the while, the town of Upper Uncton conspires to kill the Bundys outside Lower Uncton, so the curse will remain and Upper Uncton can still rake in profits as a tourist town.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: England Show - Pt 3

programme.title: Forensic Files: Line of Fire
programme.desc: In 1996, when a fundamentalist group begins robbing banks near Spokane, authorities know immediately that they are dealing with experienced criminals.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Blood
programme.desc: In rural Canada, Dr. John Schneeberger is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting one of his female patients and his step daughter. DNA tests demonstrate that the doctor is innocent, but the patient insists that he sedated and raped her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Root of All Evil
programme.desc: A suspect's former lover comes forward with a fantastic tale of murder, mutilation and cremation. But there's no way to test the story's validity — until a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist conduct tests where the cremation supposedly occurred.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Where the Blood Drops
programme.desc: Susie Mowbray was charged in her husband's death. Her son was so convinced of her innocence that he enrolled in law school, studied all of the evidence and, eventually, discovered the truth of what really happened between his parents.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Punch Line
programme.desc: In 1994, Rhoda Nathan was found murdered in a Cincinnati hotel room. When hotel employee Elwood Jones visited the emergency room with an infected hand, which he said was cut on a dumpster, the doctor recognized the injury as something else.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sibling Rivalry
programme.desc: In 1991, San Francisco pornographer Artie Mitchell was murdered in his home. His brother and business partner, who was found near the scene carrying a rifle, later confesses to shooting Artie.The question is whether the shooting was premeditated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out Of The Grave
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: Klovn: Bedragsholms Slott

programme.title: Klovn: Bispebjerg-tricket
programme.desc: Frank och Mia tittar på ett hus där den förre ägarens fru är död, men kroppen aldrig hittades. Niels berättar hemligheten bakom Bispebjerg-tricket för Casper och Frank - det närmaste man kan komma sex med någon annan utan att vara otrogen.

programme.title: Klovn: Kram Och Mugg
programme.desc: Frank väntar otåligt på att vännen och kollegan Casper ska bli bättre och under tiden hjälper han Mia lite halvt i te-butiken. Plötsligt vaknar Casper till och har en ny idé. Mias 12-årige brorson är på besök och Frank tycker att de är konstiga.

programme.title: Klovn: Amatörerna
programme.desc: Frank och Mia har flyttat till landet och går på en boskapsutställning tillsammans med Casper. Dagen där på upptäcker Mia att de köpt en ko. För att lära känna lokalbefolkningen ställer Frank och Mia upp i stadens årliga skådespel.

programme.title: Klovn: Falskt Skit Alarm
programme.desc: Frank och Mia åker på skidsemester tillsammans med Iben och Casper. Ett prat om orgasmer leder till både en obekväm situation och tankar på giftermål.

programme.title: Klovn: Det Muslimska Pianot
programme.desc: Frank och Mia ska köpa ett begagnat piano. När Frank får reda på att säljaren är muslim tar han över förhandlingarna. Sådana saker kräver en man.

programme.title: Klovn: Baked Alaska
programme.desc: Frank vill gå med i cykellaget ”Mountain Lions”. Erik Clausen är lagets nestor, men är allvarligt sjuk. Frank gör allt han kan för att leva upp till kraven.

programme.title: Klovn: #metoo
programme.desc: Frank är ute efter hämnd efter det att Mia blivit förödmjukad av Per Pallesen i sin tesalong. Lene får besök av en god gammal norsk vän som driver Casper till vansinne med vilda machohistorier från Norge. Alltid mer vilda än något Casper har upplevt.

programme.title: Klovn: Gottegrisen

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi

programme.desc: Dingo Channel har uppenbart snott idéer från iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie och Spencer går till Dingos Studio för att säga manusförfattarna ett sanningens ord.

programme.title: iCarly: De kysstes
programme.desc: När Sam av misstag avslöjar för Carly att hon och Freddie i hemlighet har kysst varandra, konfronterar Carly dem båda och undrar varför de aldrig har berättat det för henne. Spencer besöker ett fängelse och håller en konstlektion med fångarna.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Legenden om Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Leonardo är orolig over Karai och lyckas övertyga de andra att följa med och rädda henne. Samtidigt stjäl en mästertjuv Shredders hjälm, vilken plötsligt hamnar i sköldpaddornas händer.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Plan 10
programme.desc: Raphaels temperament gör så att han hamnar i trubbel, då han av misstag skadar en maskin som får honom att byta kropp med en Kraang.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Hämnden är min
programme.desc: Leonardo går bakom Splinters rygg och initierar ett räddningsuppdrag för Karai, vars hämndbegär mot Shredder leder till svåra konsekvenser för dem alla.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: En spökhistoria från Chinatown
programme.desc: Medan Donnie blir mer och mer svartsjuk på Aprils och Caseys förhållande, så blir April plötsligt kidnappad av en ond ande som försöker tömma henne på hennes krafter.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: In i Dimension X!
programme.desc: Hemma så lyckas alltid Mikey klanta till allt, men när sköldpaddorna hamnar i den bisarra verkligheten i Dimension X, så är han den enda som förstår sig på stället.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Invasionen: Del 1
programme.desc: Leo och Donnie har olika åsikter om hur de ska stoppa Kraang-invasionen. Leo begår ett stort misstag och kommer från gruppen och Donnie måste axla rollen som ledare.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Invasionen: Del 2
programme.desc: Leo och Donnie har olika åsikter om hur de ska stoppa Kraang-invasionen. Leo begår ett stort misstag och kommer från gruppen och Donnie måste axla rollen som ledare.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Ute i Skogen
programme.desc: Gänget måste börja inse att det är möjligt att Leo inte tillfrisknar, samtidigt som allting blir värre: en ny mutant tillfångatar Raph!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: En Väldigt Stor Fot
programme.desc: Turtles upptäcker en Storfot i skogen, som Donnie blir kompis med, och insisterar på att dom ska skydda den från en jägare.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Dolda Hemligheter
programme.desc: Gänget hittar ett Kraang-skepp som begravts under Aprils hus där dom hittar Aprils mamma! Men när April återförenas med sin mamma, är hon verkligen den äkta varan?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Grodupproret
programme.desc: En upprörd Mikey rymmer hemifrån och blir kompis med en mutant-groda i skogen. När han upptäcker att Grod-familjen tänker anfalla människorna, måste han komma på ett sätt att stoppa dom.

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna

programme.desc: In the Vietnam War the USAF discovered that 90% of their casualties occurred during pilots first 10 missions. So a specialized training exercise was developed to provide pilots with the same combat missions they could expect in their first 10 missions.

programme.title: On the Case: Left in the Dark
programme.desc: When a beautiful young graduate student is found stabbed to death, detectives must determine if the murder was a crime of passion or a brutal attack by a violent intruder.

programme.title: On the Case: A Thin Disguise
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger ambushes a family as they pull into their driveway. Could the memories of a five year old girl be the key to solving the crime?

programme.title: On the Case: Stolen Dreams
programme.desc: John Greathouse finds his stepdaughter, Kelli Bailey, murdered in her bedroom; investigators find a video tape and a dead man's forged check and hope these clues will be the keys to bringing Bailey's cold-blooded killer to justice.

programme.title: On the Case: She Wasn't Alone
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman is viciously murdered just 24 hours after she was engaged to be married.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder in Room 205
programme.desc: A young woman's journey to a new life comes to a savage end in a roadside motel.

programme.title: On the Case: Cry on My Shoulder
programme.desc: When a young woman disappears, police zero in on her violent ex-boyfriend. But the secret to solving the case is buried in a cold case file.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The Doghouse
programme.desc: Duane's decision to leave the Electra crew unsupervised while he spends time at home jeopardizes the completion of a major contract, and could cost him his job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Strip
programme.desc: Mechanic Jimmy is sent to a northern mining camp to create an ice landing strip on a remote lake where AJ will have to land a DC-3 and the much bigger C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Expect the Unexpected
programme.desc: Engine troubles on the C-46 during the valley run force Devan to shut down an engine. High winds wreak havoc for Devan and his crew on another C-46 mission to help clean up an oil spill in the Northwest Territories.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Coming Home
programme.desc: Rookie waterbomber pilot Scott gets his first taste of action when Buffalo responds to an emergency callout to fight fires in Alberta. Mikey and Rod think they hit the jackpot when they buy a million dollar firefighting plane on eBay at a bargain price.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dark Skies
programme.desc: When Yellowknife and the northern aviation community are rocked by three crashes in the space of a month, Joe places an extra emphasis on safety, which is why he only trusts himself to perform a dangerous-looking DC-3 stunt.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Shut Down
programme.desc: Joe receives a negative visit from Transport Canada when inspectors threaten to shut down the airline. Ray and the Electra crew fly to Sachs Harbour to pick up a unique load - the hides, wool, and meat of 250 musk oxen.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Laurence Dromard Case
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want her dead.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
programme.desc: On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. She made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.desc: In Hitler’s Germany, those with Jewish ancestry faced harsh Nuremberg Laws. Full Jews faced death; Mischlinge endured discrimination, job bans. Some, like Helmut Schmidt, unaware of heritage, found protectors like Milch in high places.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: In Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler's secret agenda is to rid Germany of Jews. By 1938, after creating work schemes and rearming, he orchestrates "The Night of Broken Glass," burning 1,000 synagogues and killing 91 Jews, preparing for further aggression.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2708

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2709
programme.desc: För ett år sedan lämnade Jesper sin flickvän Sussie, som också är mamma till deras dotter. Inte för att han inte älskade henne och ville ha ett liv med henne och hans dotter, utan på grund av hans spelberoende.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2710
programme.desc: I Glesborg har Camilla tappat kontrollen över sin ekonomi och slänger räkningarna direkt i papperskorgen. Hon har inte ens börjat betala av sina skulder, som har vuxit till över 700 000 danska kronor.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
programme.desc: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
programme.desc: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Teen Mom 2
programme.desc: Det blir spänt inför Jenelles bröllopsdag, Kailyn står inför att uppfostra sitt tredje barn själv, Briana försöker få Devoin mer engagerad, Chelsea provar sin bröllopsklänning, och Leahs döttrar är tillbaka i skolan.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Chanel and Sterling DIV
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av 'Ridiculousness' diskuterar Rob, Chanel och Steelo de med starka armar men 'Noll pricksäkerhet', argt folk på landet i 'Nä, nu ha' ni klanta' er' och kvinnor som är 'Singel och löjlig'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Post Malone
programme.desc: On an all-new episode of Ridiculousness, rapper Post Malone joins Rob, Chanel, and Steelo to ball with some REALLY WHITE IVERSONS, get messy with the category SAUCIN' ON YOU and show off some KNUCKLE TATS.

programme.title: MTV Cribs SV: Ariel Winter / Miles Chamley- Watson / Jacquees
programme.desc: Skådespelerskan Ariel Winter visar upp sitt pokeransikte och sin ljusa Kalifornien-lya. OS-fäktaren Miles Chamley-Watson visar oss sin flotta lägenhet i Los Angeles. Sen får vi se R&B-kungen Jacquees rymliga villa i Atlanta.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness blir Rob, Steelo och gästen Nina Agdal riktigt viga när de går ner i 'Oavsiktlig spagat' blir bästisar med 'Djurparksvänner' och bryter höften i 'Cykeltrickande boomers'.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Ricci konfronterar Chantelle om att hon sagt att deras fling inte betydde någott. Det tar skruv! Hans goda avsikter slår också fel när han försöker förklara för James Leah att Jays fräcka kommentarer var oskyldiga... Chockerande!

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Reunion
programme.desc: Gör deltagarna sällskap i ett återföreningsavsnitt för att ta farväl och återuppleva de mest chockerande ögonblicken i Jersey Shores historia. Programledare är Amy Paffrath.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore: After The Show
programme.desc: Programledaren Vinny Guadagnino och gänget från 'Floribama Shore' får sällskap av en studiopublik, och ska diskutera säsongsfinalen och allt som har hänt under säsongen.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 606
programme.desc: Det exploderar bokstavligen när superduon Henrik och Ola Conny lagar mat som ett team. Restaurangchefen håller en strikt linje och har stora ambitioner innan Kjartan anländer för menyprovningen.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 511
programme.desc: Det är serveringsdag på Camp kulinaris. De två teamen kommer att servera mexikansk mat från sina respektive foodtrucks i Kragerøs centrum. Det röda laget står inför nya utmaningar.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 512
programme.desc: Det är tävlingsdag på Camp Kulinaris. Det förlorande laget från gårdagens servering måste försvara sin plats i en hektisk kamp.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 513
programme.desc: Det är en ny vecka på Camp Kulinaris. Deltagarna ska välja en restaurangchef, och Kjartan har en stor överraskning som kommer att förändra dynamiken i gruppen.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 514
programme.desc: Det är dags för menysmakning på Camp Kulinaris. Utmaningarna står på tur efter varandra, och restaurangchefen kämpar med förtroendet till en av deltagarna.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 515
programme.desc: Det är serveringsdag på Camp Kulinaris. Efter en varierad menysmakning igår har deltagarna mycket att bevisa. Kan restaurangchefen vända skeppet?

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 312
programme.desc: Vi möter Angelina gjort bröstkirurgi 11 gånger. I sökandet efter drömbrösten reser hon till Miami, där hon lägger in 1500 ml i brösten och det slutar med att de blir så stora att de spricker.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 308
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet möter vi Britt, som är upprörd både över utseendet på hennes bröst och den smärta hon fått efter en mastektomi och drömmer om ett bröllop med fina bröst och utan smärta.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 306
programme.desc: Vi möter Jeanette som känner sig som en försökskanin efter en rad misslyckade operationer.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 705
programme.desc: Som 21-åring drömmer Simone om runda och fylliga bröst. Hon genomgår en bröstförstoring som slutar med en inflammation varpå hon gör flera omoperationer, innan hon säger stopp till kirurgen.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 406
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet möter vi Anita som vaknade upp med större bröst än vad hon hade kommit överens om med kirurgen och som nu känner sig som en miniversion av Linse Kessler.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 102
programme.desc: Två av landets bästa kirurger är redo att hjälpa människor som fått betala ett högt pris för sin jakt efter ungdom och skönhet. Ta reda på om dessa misslyckade operationer kan korrigeras.

programme.desc: Sammi försöker lista ur vad Ronnie gjorde på klubben, men alla tiger. När Angelina stör Pauly får vi se en ny sida av den annars så lugne mannen.

programme.desc: Angelina sväljer stoltheten och ber tjejerna om ursäkt. Mike, Vinny och Pauly får några bottennapp i bubbelpoolen medan Ron smyger vidare bakom ryggen på Sammi.

programme.desc: Sammi hittar Snookis och Jennis brev och gör slut med Ronnie 'för gott' - eller i alla fall 'för en tid'. Mike, Vinny och Pauly (MVP) trasslar ihop sig med fyra tjejer på en kväll.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Not So Shore
programme.desc: Det anonyma brevet orsakar spänning bland tjejerna och exploderar i en ordentlig catfight. Efter ytterligare en natt med Vinny, avslöjar Snooki en inte okänd hemlighet om sin ögoninflammationsbenägne kramkompis.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The models take part in a runway show featuring fashion designs by Kim, Kourtney and Khloe Kardashian; guest judge La Toya Jackson guides the models during a photo shoot.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The models play a game of flag football with professional football players, during which they pause for photos; the all-stars pose alongside supermodel Coco Rocha.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The models create a signature fragrance and launch the scent at a public event while posing in a bathtub; tension is high during a photo shoot where the women pose as reality stars; guest judge Kathy Griffin.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The models struggle when they are asked to write and sing a song about their lives; rapper Game directs the women in music videos.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The women head to Greece where they collaborate with designer Michael Cinco; one model is conflicted when asked to pose in underwear.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Appearance Counts
programme.desc: DCC-makeoverdagen är kritisk för några av tjejerna. Dagen bjuder Kelli på några stora överraskningar och Jinelle får nästan skrämselhicka. Tessa avslöjar resultatet av hennes läkarbesök innan ett kämpigt danspass.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Game Day
programme.desc: Tjejerna har en sista chans innan deras öde avgörs. Drömmar börjar slå in när tjejerna poserar för truppfotot. Det bjuds på fantastisk dans när showgruppen och resten av truppen uppträder på nya "Meet the Team"-eventet för första gången.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Journey Begins
programme.desc: Följ med och se vilka som kommer att klara de svåraste dansuttagningarna i sportvärlden. 500 kvinnor satsar allt för drömmen att bli en av de berömda Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders för 2014-2015 års säsong.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dancing For Your Life
programme.desc: 55 tjejer i toppklass har tagit sig till final, vilket är inte är så roligt för de 30 veteranerna som nu måste kämpa för sin plats i truppen. Kitty Carter håller inte tillbaka när hon förbereder tjejerna för sina solodanser.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Welcome to Valley Ranch
programme.desc: När träningslägret inleds med 43 kvinnor blir trycket stort! Kellis entusiasm smittar av sig, men första mötet är också upprörande. Förväntningarna är skyhöga. Sju tjejer måste åka hem för att truppen ska kunna bestå av 36.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: A Week Of Firsts

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina flyttar till ett eget ställe i hopp om att Justin ska flytta ihop med henne, men alla är oroliga att hon flyttar av fel skäl. Heidi bjuder Spencer på ett jobbevenemang och ertappas på bar gärning med att ha lite för kul.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney reser till New York och förväntar sig att träffa Alex, men får i stället upp ögonen för Jay. Heidi är deppad över att ha fått sparken, men när Spencer går till Brent i ett försök att hjälpa henne få jobbet tillbaka gör han saken etter värre.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren låter Heidis syster sova över hos henne. Justin bjuder Audrina på en romantisk helgresa och Heidis frustration över Spencer växer när hon måste böna och be om att få jobbet tillbaka.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på ett rykte hon får höra: Att Lauren har haft ihop det med Justin. Samtidigt försöker Holly hålla Heidi och Spencer åtskilda.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina försöker rädda sin vänskap med Lauren efter att ha anklagat henne för att ha haft ihop det med Justin. Spencer och Stephanie besöker sin mormor som är trött på allt deras bråk.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney har chansen att få sitt drömjobb i New York och hoppas att träffa Jay där. Lauren blir nostalgisk när hennes föräldrar säljer sitt hus i Laguna Beach. Stephanie vänder sig till Spencer för hjälp när hon inte vet vad hon ska göra med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer och Heidi struntar i deras familjers farhågor och flyr till Mexiko för att gifta sig. Whitney satsar på ett drömjobb i New York och tar farväl av Lauren och sitt liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren och Heidi lägger osämjan åt sidan och minns varför de var vänner. Spencer och Heidi måste ta itu med det hemliga giftermålet när Heidis mamma hälsar på. Audrina får en chock när Justin tar med henne till Palm Springs för en överraskning.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: När Heidi dyker upp på Laurens födelsedagsfest gråter de båda vännerna över sin förstörda vänskap, och Spencer vill slåss när Cameron anklagar honom för att stöta på en bartender.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers flörtande får Heidi att åka hem till Colorado där hon träffar en gammal pojkvän. Lauren läxar upp Stephanie för att hon bjöd Heidi på födelsedagsfesten - och Spencer börjar prata med Brody igen.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Episod 505

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 601

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Just Apologise Sophie

programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer SV
programme.desc: År 1945 fördes världen in i atomåldern. Med sin roll som bombens fader befäst blev Oppenheimer alltmer oroad över den potentiella fara som vetenskapliga uppfinningar kunde utgöra för mänskligheten.

programme.title: Hitlers Dödspatruller
programme.desc: När Nazityskland invaderade Polen 1939 och Sovjetunionen 1941 följde särskilda insatsgrupper (Einsatzgruppen) i den tyska arméns fotspår.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
programme.desc: All-terrain Air Commander Hovercraft, a 1970s NASA countdown clock and a one-of-a-kind 1960s Delta Relay rocket.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Big Score
programme.desc: At a climate-controlled storage facility in downtown L.A., Allen and Ton's locker wins score them an antique cash register and a German H&K pistol prized by collectors.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Bowling Pin Payday
programme.desc: Allen & Ton visit Ton's old stompin' ground and go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer. They uncover a 19th century rifle with a matching cutlass bayonet and a mechanical bowling pinsetter from the early 1960's!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore: After The Show
programme.desc: Programledaren Vinny Guadagnino och gänget från 'Floribama Shore' får sällskap av en studiopublik, och ska diskutera säsongsfinalen och allt som har hänt under säsongen.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Mike Tyson
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av "Ridiculousness" kommer den Störste, Mike Tyson, för att prata med Rob, Chanel och Steelo om folk som är "Nere i första ronden", hur man leker "Tittut" och hur irriterad man blir på "Onda som fän":

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I ett rykande färskt 'Ridiculousness' ska Rob, Chanel och Steelo bråka på motorvägen i 'Vapen för trafikraseri', dricka och spela i 'Barkaden' och klä sig sjaskigt i 'Snuskiga T-shirt-snubbar'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Rick Ross
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness välkomnar Rob, Chanel och Steelo raplegenden Rick Ross för att behålla lugnet 'I stormens öga', förundras av 'Big Tyme-bestar' och njuta av stark sås i 'Vingligt'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness klär Rob, Chanel och Steelo ut sig för 'Halloween året runt', kämpar med tekniken i 'Inte redo frö framtiden' och blir tagna på bar gärning i 'Typ ensamma'.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Slutet blir då inte gott i Geordie Shore-finalen. Gaz har nåt allvarligt att berätta för Charlotte, Jay och Vickys förhållande exploderar chockartat, och Holly hamnar i bråk på en parkering.

programme.title: Teen Mom 2: Nothing Stays the Same
programme.desc: Festtjejen Jennelles mamma vill ha vårdnaden om baby Jace, medan Leah försöker vinna tillbaka tvillingarnas pappa. Chelsea och baby Aubree flyttar ut och Kailyns pojkvän gör slut med henne.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: James Needs To Score
programme.desc: Ingen har tid att sörja över Charlottes avsked när Vicky och Riccis nattsömn störs av ett oväntat besök. Samtidigt slösar Gary och James ingen tid på att klä av sig!

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 515
programme.desc: Det är serveringsdag på Camp Kulinaris. Efter en varierad menysmakning igår har deltagarna mycket att bevisa. Kan restaurangchefen vända skeppet?

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 516
programme.desc: Det är tävlingsdag på Camp Kulinaris och Linda står inför ett svårt val. Deltagarnas smaklökar sätts på prov och Bahareh är missnöjd med kaffeproduktionen.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 517
programme.desc: Det är framdukat för en annorlunda vecka på Camp Kulinaris. Deltagarna kastas in i en stor utmaning, som skapar både glädje och frustration i köket.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 518
programme.desc: Trioveckan fortsätter på Camp Kulinaris. De tre lagen får äntligen veta vad de ska servera imorgon och stämningen försämras i köket.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 519
programme.desc: Det är serveringsdag på Camp Kulinaris. De tre lagen ska laga japanska rätter inför gästerna och det blå laget kämpar med samarbetet.

programme.desc: Det är tävlingsdag på Camp Kulinaris. De två förlorande lagen från gårdagens servering får testa sitt samarbete i en kaotisk lärlingsmatch.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 404
programme.desc: Vi möter Maria, som efter en bröstförstoring fick ett hål ända upp till implantatet, och Casper, som hela sitt liv har blivit mobbad på grund av sin näsa.

programme.desc: Som tonåring var Melissa ledsen över sin killiga kropp och beslutade sig för att genomgå tre bröstförstoringsoperationer. Men nu är hon fast i ett smärthelvete som är på väg att göra henne morfinberoende.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 704

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 906
programme.desc: Mia tycker att hon efter flera operationer ser ut som någon med fyra bröst. Alice mage blir allt större och större och hon kämpar med magsyra, smärta och oönskad gråt. Kan läkarna hjälpa dem?

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 701

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: A Week Of Firsts
programme.desc: Skräck griper tag i träningslägerkandidaterna när de ställs inför det faktum att de måste göra DCC:s benspark och hoppspagat för första gången. Att landa så onaturligt kräver stor tro på sig själv.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Getting The DCC Look

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Time To Get Serious

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: A Lucid Dream

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Payoff
programme.desc: Det är träningslägrets sista dag och alla är nervösa för att Kelli och Judy ska välja ut en trupp med färre än 36 medlemmar. Efter några tuffa beslut förvandlas skräck till glädje när sluttruppen kungörs.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dare To Dream

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions

programme.title: Secret War: The Scholar and the Fight for Greece
programme.desc: Monty Woodhouse, a professor and a legend for blowing up the Gorgopotamos Bridge in Greece in 1942. In the British counter attack against Rommell at Al Alamein in North Africa it was vital to disrupt German supply routes, Greece.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World

programme.title: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Miami cops Will Smith and Martin Lawrence are two loose cannons who tear up the Sunshine State in search of stolen drugs. Co-starring Tea Leoni. Explosive direction by Michael Bay (Armageddon).

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: The action and comedy never stop when Martin Lawrence and Will Smith reunite as out-of-control, trash-talking buddy cops. Bullets fly, cars crash, and laughs explode as they pursue a whacked-out drug lord from the streets of Miami to the barrios of Cuba.

programme.title: Silat Warriors: Deed of Death
programme.desc: When a young gambler runs afoul of the gang rigging a local betting ring, his luck soon runs out. When they show up to collect, he faces dire consequences, and his siblings must fight for their land and their lives—before time runs out.

programme.title: Shadow Master
programme.desc: After being slain by a group of criminals, a man is reborn with animal-like superpowers and makes it his mission to right the wrongs of his city.

programme.title: The Game Changer

programme.title: Code Name: The Cleaner

programme.title: Like a Boss

programme.title: Miss Congeniality

programme.title: The Family Stone

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: The Virgin Suicides
programme.desc: In the mid-1970s, in a Michigan community, live the Lisbon sisters, five teenagers who have bewitched a group of neighborhood boys.

programme.title: Dream Scenario
programme.desc: A hapless family man (Nicolas Cage) finds his life turned upside down when millions of strangers suddenly see him in their dreams and his newfound stardom takes a nightmarish turn. A wickedly entertaining comedy from producer Ari Aster.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama, which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck, tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse

programme.title: Django Unchained

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: Rush Hour 2

programme.title: Rush Hour 3

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.

programme.title: The Babadook

programme.title: The Godfather

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: A Time to Kill

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dynamite

programme.desc: From director Arthur Penn (BONNIE AND CLYDE), Dustin Hoffman, Chief Dan George, Faye Dunaway, Martin Balsam, Jeff Corey and Richard Mulligan star in a genre-defying tale of an alleged 121-year-old white survivor of Custer's Last Stand.

programme.title: Murder on the Orient Express

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane

programme.title: Species
programme.desc: She's beautiful, seductive, intelligent, and her charms could spell doom for the entire human race! Ben Kingsley, Forrest Whitaker, and Natasha Henstridge star in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi hit.

programme.title: The Fifth Element
programme.desc: Bruce Willis, Milla Jovovich, and Gary Oldman star in acclaimed director Luc Besson's outrageous sci-fi adventure, an extravagantly styled tale of good against evil set in an unbelievable twenty-third-century world.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night: Dark Days

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Source Code
programme.desc: A helicopter pilot (Jake Gyllenhaal) takes part in a secret government program that enables him to assume someone's identity and experience the last few minutes of that person's life.

programme.title: Ender's Game

programme.title: Gamer
programme.desc: A death-row inmate (Gerard Butler) is caught between the inventor (Michael C. Hall) of a deadly online game and a group that opposes the inventor's high-tech slavery.

programme.title: Kin

programme.title: Canadian Bacon
programme.desc: Falling approval ratings and a sagging economy, cause a desperate U.S. president to turn America against its most unlikely enemy, Canada. A Niagara Falls sheriff and his band of misfit deputies invade Canada leaving the President's plans in shambles.

programme.title: Delirious
programme.desc: When a soap opera writer bumps his head and wakes up in the midst of his own daytime serial, he writes himself into the storyline of a lifetime!

programme.title: Planes, Trains & Automobiles

programme.title: Think Like a Man Too
programme.desc: All the couples are back for a wedding in Las Vegas, but plans for a romantic weekend go awry when their various misadventures get them into some compromising situations that threaten to derail the big event.

programme.title: The Wood
programme.desc: Lots of guys have second thoughts about marriage. Three hours before his wedding, Roland is having third, fourth and fifth thoughts. Good thing he’s got buddies Slim and Mike around to help.

programme.title: Coach Carter

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture - The Director's Edition

programme.desc: The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

programme.title: Creed III

programme.title: Trading Places
programme.desc: The story of a down-and-out con artist who trades lifestyles with a well-to-do investor.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.
